verdict.comment: Progressive SANTORINI STAR (nap) has been found a good opening for her first start at Listed level. Karmology is feared most.

comments.allonsy: Four handicap wins last summer; solid efforts in 2025 and this looks less taxing
comments.basbleu: Work to do with Santorini Star on latest Goodwood run; hard to recommend
comments.janetemple: Two AW wins; just over 1l behind Allonsy on turf debut latest; still open to improvement
comments.karmology: Unexposed at the trip; tough task latest but reappearance second gives her solid claims
comments.meribella: Promising return to action at Goodwood last month but has work to do with Santorini Star
comments.overture: Progressive filly but will need a clear personal best if she's to contend
comments.santorinistar: Four wins from six starts; improved for 1m4f at Goodwood last month; major player

races.raceComment: santorinistar is marginally preferred with a score of 53.9%. Won 4 of last 6 starts. Excellent course form of 4/6 at pontefract. Key attributes include positive comments and improving, though step up in class and unfavorable draw and inconsistent profile need consideration.

verdict.comment: A chance is taken on HUIT REFLETS who was too free for his own good when placed here two weeks ago and he's back in trip.

comments.allbetsoff: Second of nine to Blended Stealth here last month but dropped out very tamely a week ago
comments.blendedstealth: A winner here last month but not so good last week; now 1-37
comments.dickens: C&D winner in March and has joined another very capable trainer for £7,000
comments.earlofbrackenstown: Could yet have some improvement lurking and now goes in cheekpieces
comments.huitreflets: Beaten 3.5l over 2m4f here 15 days ago and might have threatened had he settled better
comments.lovetrue: Respectable run in a novice last time and has shown she can be competitive off this mark
comments.malangen: Fair run last time at 3m; comfortable winner of this last year when 8lb higher
comments.mrsundancer: Still early days with this yard and not beaten too far in either run following a break
comments.nationalquestion: C&D winner in November and didn't run badly on the Flat last time after wind surgery

races.raceComment: dickens is marginally preferred with a score of 59.5%, holding clear edges in better ratings and stronger recent form and superior course form and more reliable profile over blendedstealth. Won 2 of last 6 starts. Could develop into tactical affair with no obvious pace-setter. Key attributes include excellent form and optimal distance and positive comments, though inconsistent profile and regressive form need consideration.

verdict.comment: He wouldn't be one to take too short a price about but MAGGIES BOY has by far and away the most convincing pieces of form.

comments.justkeepsrolling: Won just the one of his ten point starts in Ireland and it was ordinary form overall
comments.maggiesboy: When a remote third in a maiden at Southwell it was behind horses from top yards
comments.masterminding: Regressed on the Flat and was tailed off at 250-1 on hurdling debut
comments.mayorkingston: Changing hands for only £6,000 says plenty about his point form in Ireland
comments.moonbow: Point/bumper winner; ran okay behind two Irish raiders on switch to hurdling at Perth
comments.ryebridge: Tailed off in a Perth bumper and debatable what he achieved when beaten 29l in a maiden

Could develop into tactical affair with no obvious pace-setter, though unfavorable draw and inconsistent profile need consideration.

verdict.comment: Arctic Dawn and The Hare Rail are major players on form, while MAGNETITE and Outlandish could well progress further.

comments.arcticdawn: Has made the frame in most starts; ran creditably in York handicap latest; leading player
comments.goldenredemption: 0-5 on dirt in UAE for Bhupat Seemar; best to heed the market signals on turf/yard debut
comments.magnetite: Promising third at Chepstow on reappearance; well bred and should show further progress
comments.merapi: Filly by Frankel and the first foal of a well-related 7f winner; interesting newcomer
comments.mumsangel: May do better still but is likely to be more interesting in handicaps soon
comments.outlandish: Close third at Nottingham last time; drops in distance; one of the main form contenders
comments.paliodisiena: Newcomer by Sioux Nation out of a US 7f dirt winner; market instructive
comments.pantani: Ran well from the front at Leicester last time; possibilities if building on that effort
comments.summertimeblues: Has two duck eggs next to his name
comments.theharerail: Similar type to Arctic Dawn, having made the frame in most outings; in the mix

verdict.comment: Several runners are interesting, particularly KEY WITNESS (nap). Second choice is Maybe Not, ahead of Hunky Dory.

comments.dakotapower: Somewhat interesting back at Ffos Las, being 1-1 here; both turf wins on soft ground
comments.hunkydory: Shaped well in big-field handicap at York last time; finishing nicely; possibilities
comments.keywitness: Posted a solid success in latest AW start and his opening mark looks attractive; respected
comments.lhebayeb: All wins over longer trips and in Class 6, including latest start; unlikely to follow up
comments.maybenot: Has encouraging form; dam/granddam won for her connections; interesting handicap debutante
comments.pitboss: Failed to get home over 7f last time; evidently needs a return to sprinting
comments.sustained: 0-7 since debut win; chance of doubling tally depends on how well he responds to headgear

verdict.comment: Based on recent form and other factors, CORNISH STORM (narrowly preferred) and Three Yorkshiremen are the strongest contenders.

comments.baikal: Hurdles/AW scorer; 0-13 in Flat turf events; not the percentage call
comments.cogital: Modest fourth last time; seemingly isn't anything like the force of old
comments.cornishstorm: Creditable second on Kempton AW last time; fighting chance back on turf
comments.runofluck: Dual 1m2f winner; seemingly outstayed when upped to this trip last time
comments.threeyorkshiremen: Back up only 2lb for narrow AW win last time; may well remain competitive

races.raceComment: cornishstorm is marginally preferred with a score of 48.7%, holding clear edges in better suited by conditions and superior course form and more reliable profile over threeyorkshiremen. Won 1 of last 6 starts. Going is a significant concern - yet to win on Good To Soft ground from 6 attempts. Could develop into tactical affair with no obvious pace-setter, though unfavorable draw and inconsistent profile need consideration.
